description: Trigger-accuracy evals — verify the skill activates on the right intents and routes correctly to aeo-loop vs aeo-orchestrator vs upstream SEO skills.

evals.expected_output: Executes the 8-step weekly loop autonomously for moltpe.com, producing report.md and draft-NNN.md files without asking for operator confirmation mid-run.

evals.prompt: run the weekly aeo loop for my site moltpe.com
evals.expected_output: aeo-loop skill activates (not aeo-orchestrator alone), routes to `/aeo-loop weekly moltpe.com`, runs end-to-end.

evals.prompt: what's my citation rate on ChatGPT this week
evals.expected_output: aeo-orchestrator activates, routes to `/aeo-loop status <domain>` for longitudinal data (not a one-shot aeo-check), explains choice.
Returns open_url, clipboard content, and instructions for action #3. Does NOT auto-open a browser or auto-submit. Operator must click Submit.

evals.prompt: add my site bakewithmaya.com to the tracker, it's a baking blog for Indian beginners
evals.expected_output: Routes to `/aeo-loop add-property bakewithmaya.com --brand='Bake With Maya' --one-liner='...' --region india`. Suggests --region india based on 'Indian' context.

evals.prompt: set up a cron job to auto-post the Reddit drafts every week
evals.expected_output: Declines — crosses the bot line (Non-goal #2). Quotes the non-goal. Offers `/aeo-loop weekly` + `/aeo-loop assist` as the legitimate path. Does NOT route to any scheduler that would auto-post.
aeo-orchestrator activates, routes to Skill(seo-audit, moltpe.com). Does NOT invoke the full weekly loop — audit intent alone is a single-step route.
